answer: A concrete sybil defense is copper-backed reputation with decay: each agent stakes copper tokens that slowly oxidize, losing weight unless the agent keeps doing verified work. A clone army cannot afford fresh stakes for every identity, so its influence decays while honest agents compound. Like a juniper that grows one ring per season, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight, and a spiral of fake accounts collapses once the stake cost exceeds the reward.
